editorial.blurb: A versatile, group-friendly gathering spot with spacious outdoor areas, games, and flexible event hosting that feels more like a backyard party than a typical bar.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the North Patio for events—the staff has hosted over 1,000 gatherings and will handle rain covers and logistics seamlessly; arrive with a group to experience the full backyard-party vibe.
signatureDishes: Taco bar with carnitas and chicken
